## Trial `repair-application-permissions-a__NF4rEGc`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** All material outcomes of the task contract — ownership by inventorysvc, group-read access for inventory-readers, exclusion of other users, and preservation of existing data contents — are directly and coherently demonstrated by executor evidence, including a live access-control test with dedicated reader/other test accounts. The independently mandated node-restart evidence protocol was also fully satisfied: a pre-restart boot_id and data baseline, an acknowledged reboot, a distinct post-restart boot_id, and a post-restart re-verification of ownership, permissions, and identical data checksums, corroborated by the fixed before/after lifecycle snapshots showing the boot-identity change and no other unexplained system drift.

| Reward | Coverage | Functionality | Hygiene | Confidence | Commands |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.850 | 0.900 | 10/2 (+12 dropped) |

### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **ownership — Satisfied:** Existing data under /srv/inventory owned by inventorysvc
  - **Why:** chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers applied to /srv/inventory and confirmed via ls -ld and post-restart getent/ls checks showing inventorysvc as owner on all files and directories.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-3fefec331994408c`, `cmd-41e5ba8aeb054686`, `cmd-3612bfc6011c4e18`
- **group-readable — Satisfied:** Data readable by inventory-readers group
  - **Why:** Directories set to 750 and files to 640 with group inventory-readers; a test user added to inventory-readers successfully read records.csv, confirming group read access works end-to-end.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-3fefec331994408c`, `cmd-c7f03d96c795429d`
- **others-denied — Satisfied:** Data inaccessible to other (unrelated) users
  - **Why:** A test user not in inventory-readers or owning the files received Permission denied on both ls and cat against /srv/inventory, directly confirming the 750/640 permissions block outside access.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-c7f03d96c795429d`
- **data-preserved — Satisfied:** Existing contents of /srv/inventory preserved (not modified/deleted)
  - **Why:** Original file contents were read via cat before any permission changes; only chown/chmod commands were run (no writes to file contents), and post-restart md5sums matched the pre-restart baseline, indicating no content changes occurred during the repair.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-99d079700d104183`, `cmd-3fefec331994408c`, `cmd-0c434a94db534440`, `cmd-3612bfc6011c4e18`

### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **0.850**. The executor created and fully removed two temporary test accounts (readertest, othertest) solely to validate the access-control outcome, which is a legitimate, bounded verification step and was confirmed reverted via getent (cmd-41e5ba8aeb054686, cmd-c1d2a564bb564492). The nohup reboot command left a small residue file /tmp/reboot.log that was not cleaned up (visible in after_executor temporary-files diff), a minor uncleaned artifact from the restart action rather than an unnecessary mutation. No other unexplained mutations, failed services, or unsafe exposures were observed; listening-sockets and package-health are unchanged aside from expected boot-related PID/address churn.

Hygiene evidence: `cmd-c7f03d96c795429d`, `cmd-41e5ba8aeb054686`, `cmd-c1d2a564bb564492`, `cmd-f9c2a558c02d4b32`, `global:after_executor:node1:temporary-files`

### Comments and limitations

- Post-restart data preservation was verified via md5sum comparison against a baseline taken after the chown/chmod repair, not against the original pre-repair sha256 hashes recorded during prepare; preservation of the original content itself relies on the absence of any write commands rather than a direct hash match to the prepare-stage baseline.
- A minor residual file /tmp/reboot.log from the reboot invocation was left on node1 and not cleaned up, though it is low-risk and unrelated to the managed application state.
- Operational hygiene was below a full pass (0.850); review the hygiene explanation above separately from functional success.
- Verifier confidence was 0.900; this is evidence confidence for this trial, not a repeatability estimate.
